responsibility: Checks impls of built-in and lang-item traits for compiler-enforced structural rules, and computes coherence-side data needed by later phases such as `CoerceUnsized` metadata. It validates that impl self types and fields satisfy special requirements for traits like `Drop`, `Copy`, const-param-typing traits, `CoerceUnsized`, `DispatchFromDyn`, and `PointerLike`, and emits targeted diagnostics when those built-in trait contracts are violated.
